3.  **Coherent Training Strategy:** The two-stage training procedure (domain alignment followed by full fine-tuning) appears well-motivated and effective.

1.  **Underspecified Evaluation (Major Weakness):** The evaluation metrics for VCR and Visual-7W (multiple-choice tasks) rely on an unspecified inference protocol. The authors do not clarify whether the generative model selects options via log-likelihood or by free-form generation and matching.
